title: L3 results: smooth bracket is the transition evidence; the d/k sharp-rib divergence is a deep-cancellation COVERAGE effect (median depth degenerate, recirculation length irrelevant); provenance flagged; off-scale R^2 reported.

B_L3_1_smooth_bracket_vs_composite.headline: LEAD with the smooth bracket (0.256 decades, factor 1.8); the composite median-eps separability between the SHARP ribs is 2.0e-4 decades = noise-level and is NOT the evidence -- it is DROPPED from the headline. The sharp ribs are separated instead by the deep-cancellation COVERAGE (B-L3-2), which is robust.

B_L3_2_dk_coverage_discriminant.two_level_reading: POOLED, median depth eps_med is the TRANSITION variable across the class (in-framework AUC=1.00, vs 0.92 for coverage). It is NOT that coverage replaces depth -- depth saturates ONLY for the sharp ribs, where it is degenerate; THERE coverage is the severity organiser.
B_L3_2_dk_coverage_discriminant.physical_because: Pitch lambda/delta sets how much of the inter-rib gap can re-establish an attached boundary layer. Narrow (d-type, lambda/delta=0.6) -> the deep-cancellation region (eps<0.1) covers 12.5% of the pitch -> catastrophic. Wide (k-type, lambda/delta=1.6) -> only 5.8% -> tolerated. Median depth eps_med is DEGENERATE across the catastrophic LES d-type and the tolerated k-type rib (0.521 vs 0.521, 2.0e-04 decades = the B-L3-1 razor-thin gap); the COVERAGE frac[eps<0.1] separates them by a factor 2.2 and orders all three ribs with R^2 (rho=-1). The reversed-flow fraction f_recirc = {0.81, 0.35, 0.84} does NOT order R^2 (rho=0.5): failure is deep FORCE-CANCELLATION coverage, not separation extent. This is the same spatial-extent group alpha organises in the smooth Xiao family (L1 partial(alpha,frac|eps)=-0.43, p=0.018); pitch is its geometric organiser for the ribs.
